heroSummary: Davis School District students begin Thursday, August 20, 2026. Secondary schools follow the printed A/B rotation and start late on Wednesdays; elementary schools dismiss early on Fridays. Graduation ceremonies are scheduled for May 25–28, and the final student day is Friday, May 28, 2027. Students are off February 12 unless DSD uses it as an inclement-weather make-up day.
calendarNotes: Davis School District students begin August 20, two days later than the prior school year's main opening. Secondary schools follow the printed A/B rotation and late-start Wednesdays, while elementary schools dismiss early on Fridays. Quarter 1 ends on an early-out day October 13, followed by a professional day and Fall Break before Quarter 2 begins October 19. Thanksgiving combines a November 25 teacher compensation day with the November 26–27 break. Winter Break runs December 21–January 1, and professional days January 4–5 keep students out until January 6. February 12 is scheduled as a compensation day but may become a weather make-up day, with the compensation day moved elsewhere. Spring Break runs April 5–9, graduation ceremonies are May 25–28, and the final student day is May 28.

customSections.label: Three Schedules Share the Same Calendar
customSections.content: Davis uses the same school-year calendar across grade levels, but the weekly schedule works differently by school level. Junior high and high school students have late starts on Wednesdays and follow the A/B rotation. Elementary schools dismiss early on Fridays. The PDF does not publish one districtwide bell time.

customSections.label: Why February 12 Is Conditional
customSections.content: Friday, February 12, 2027, is scheduled as a teacher compensation day with no school. DSD may use the date as a make-up day if school closes earlier in the year because of inclement weather. If that happens, the compensation day would be rescheduled. After a closure, families should verify both February 12 and the replacement compensation date with the district rather than relying on an earlier calendar import.

customSections.label: Parent-Teacher Conference Weeks by School Level
customSections.content: High school conferences are held on Mondays and Tuesdays, while junior high conferences are held on Wednesdays and Thursdays; each school sets its own schedule. Elementary schools dismiss early each school day during the September and February conference weeks. May conferences do not change dismissal times and apply only to students who need a new Individual Reading Plan (IRP).

customSections.label: Terms, Semesters, and Graduation Week
customSections.content: The approved calendar includes 174 student days: 80 in the first semester and 94 in the second. Graduation ceremonies are scheduled Tuesday through Friday of the final student week, before Memorial Day on May 31.

whatsNew.title: 2026–27 Compared With 2025–26
content: The first day of school moves from August 18, 2025, to August 20, 2026. The approved revision followed community feedback seeking a later start.
The last student day moves from May 22 to May 28, and the calendar schedules graduation ceremonies May 25–28 before Memorial Day.
The first semester falls from 84 to 80 student days, while the second rises from 90 to 94; both calendars still total 174 student days.
The 2026–27 calendar designates February 12 as a possible inclement-weather make-up day, a conditional rule not printed on the 2025–26 PDF.

In 2025–26, elementary schools chose two of three conference options. For 2026–27, the district lists conference weeks in September, February, and May. The May conferences are only for students who need a new IRP and do not use early dismissal.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Davis School District start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Davis School District students start Thursday, August 20, 2026. Elementary schools use the early-out schedule on the first day, while secondary students follow an A-day schedule.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Davis School District Fall Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break is October 15–16, 2026. Students also have no school October 14 for professional development and return Monday, October 19.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Davis School District Winter Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. Students remain out January 4–5 for professional development and return Wednesday, January 6.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Davis School District Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, April 5, through Friday, April 9, 2027. Students return Monday, April 12.

calendarFaqs.q: Is February 12, 2027 always a no-school day in Davis?
calendarFaqs.a: No. It is scheduled as a teacher compensation day, but DSD may hold school February 12 if an inclement-weather closure requires a make-up day and then reschedule the compensation day.

calendarFaqs.q: When are Davis School District graduations in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The district calendar schedules high school graduation ceremonies May 25–28, 2027. Families should use their high school's announcement for the assigned date, time, and venue.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school in Davis School District?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Friday, May 28, 2027. Quarter 4 ends, elementary schools use the recurring Friday early-dismissal schedule, and secondary schools use an A/B day.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the downloadable Davis calendar update if February 12 changes?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The MySchoolDates ICS file is a one-time import. It does not update automatically, repeat daily A/B letters, or add every weekly late-start and early-dismissal event.
